result.summary: Independent frozen-manifest audit of Build R5 (observability and controlled comparisons) over 8920ffac→cc010ccd. The implementation matches the approved R5 requirements: R5.1 $writes unwrapping with a non-mutation regression against the real LangGraph producer; R5.2 allowlisted agent/exception-class diagnostics with secrets still redacted; R5.3 unconditional per-node transcript pointers plus persisted past_context/memory_note; R5.4 failed-attempt usage receipts with run-ID dedup and an explicit graph_only metrics boundary (the plan's permitted labeling alternative); R5.5 default-off private 0600 stage traces with ordered sequences, incomplete marking, env-secret redaction, and bounded requested/actual model provenance available without full tracing; R5.6 hash-verified source replay bound to ticker/clock/settings/stage/arguments/occurrence, typed-failure replay without raw diagnostics, re-executed search Command updates with current call IDs, explicit replay_miss/mixed-input taxonomy, tamper/symlink/overlap-rejecting pre-baseline snapshots with isolated writable clones, replay-disabled checkpointing, and rejection of resumed traces as baselines. All plan-named tests for R5.1–R5.6 are present; the native CLI pair proof shows one replay hit, zero misses, 12/12 model callbacks, equal starting snapshots, and unchanged baseline stores. Verdicts: merge integrity consistent; local R5 feature acceptance supported with disclosed fixture-only provider evidence; full-suite health green only per the builder receipt at 5b01bc1f; remote CI unverified (local unpushed branch, correctly not claimed). No critical or high finding. Six non-blocking findings: the four-role agent allowlist leaves other structured agents' fallback logs stage-anonymous; baseline live-store isolation is procedural (disclosed, needs a user decision); nonfinite floats in traced events poison a baseline; non-typed provider failures always force mixed-input; Timestamp type identity is not exactly preserved; and the suite receipt is one docs-only commit behind HEAD with tree equality builder-asserted.
limitations: Frozen-evidence-only audit: no test execution, runtime verification, network, or repository access beyond the supplied request.json; all pytest/Ruff/native-drill results are builder-supplied receipts, not independently rerun.

Production structured-output callers (tradingagents/agents/audit_pass.py, research_manager.py, trader.py, analyst agents) were not in the packet; the reachable set of agent names outside the run-logging allowlist is unverified, so finding 1 is partially confirmed.

The concatenated requirements context has no filename headers; file boundaries were inferred from content, and some unchanged neighboring source (e.g., cli/selections.py, graph/checkpointer.py, reporting.render_token_usage body) was absent or only partially inspectable.

Live-provider behavior is unproven by design at this stage: model callbacks, usage receipts on error, and Yahoo metadata shapes were exercised with fixtures (FakeListChatModel, OfflineModel, synthetic sources); on_llm_error delivering a response kwarg from real providers is unverified.

result.summary: Independent frozen-manifest closure audit of Build R5 (observability and controlled comparisons) over cc010ccd→7050666f, following completed first audit 44749b33 on cc010ccd. Scope: 11 changed paths (~1,278 diff lines; declared large, correctly escalated to extra large). The diff is exactly the builder-disclosed R5.6 closure batch plus committed receipts, and every closure claim maps to real code and a named regression in the frozen tests: (1) direct StockTwits/Reddit acquisitions now journal raw bytes via external_input with current parsing/windowing re-executed (parametrized test proves frozen raw + current render, limit 2→1); (2) Yahoo reference history journals raw bars/metadata through recorded_history while _project reruns on the candidate (test injects a candidate projection marker and asserts identical raw_source, zero misses); (3) the threaded TypeSafe screen journals status/parsed-JSON/retry-after only (never headers), propagates contextvars into workers via copy_context, and a screen that leaves requests in flight sets unfinished_sources, which finish() folds into the session-end incomplete flag and ReplaySession._load rejects as a baseline (two-worker race test); (4) comparison scope now binds quick provider, efforts, temperature, max_tokens, retries and tool-round bound — all keys verified present in default_config — with a 4-parameter refusal test matching 'scope'; (5) UTF-8 bytes round-trip via a dedicated pack/unpack marker, non-UTF-8 and credential-scrubbed payloads are explicitly non-replayable (replayable = cleaned==packed) so a scrubbed secret forces a visible mixed-input miss rather than a silent replay (test asserts secret and its hex absent from the journal); (6) date_window undated-item and coverage_gap decisions use the session's frozen observed_at inside a session, with reddit's _coverage_dates aligned, so baseline and candidate classify identically (observed_at is restored from the baseline trace on load); (7) reference-history acquisition time is journaled as its own yahoo_reference_clock input bound to ticker+history-start, preserving truthful live acquisition time (22:00 test) and identical replay request windows; (8) cli/run.py exposes unfinished_sources in replay_context. Integrity chain is coherent: loader enforces single start/end, contiguous sequences, payload and identity digests, scope equality, and rejects incomplete/unfinished traces; snapshot capture/clone preserve sizes, hashes and mtime_ns so baseline/candidate starting-snapshot digests legitimately match. The two disproved first-audit Mediums were re-checked against the newly supplied caller bodies and the disproofs hold: structured.py's diagnostic extras are produced for exactly the four production agent_name values that call bind/invoke_structured at HEAD (Trader, Research Manager, Portfolio Manager, Sentiment Analyst — audit_pass does not use the helper), matching the run_logging allowlist; and R5.6/Sequence 6–7 define baseline isolation as the documented disposable-store procedure using capture/clone_starting_snapshot, not automatic diversion of ordinary traced runs. Verdicts — Merge integrity: consistent; changed paths match the declared closure scope, the post_screen change does not alter whether the screen runs (the plan's not-in-scope item), and no protected contract (publication immutability, rating eligibility, evidence gating) is touched. Feature acceptance (local R5, closure stage): supported by the committed-candidate receipts at 0308e892 (full suite 3358 passed, Ruff clean, repeated native CLI pair with one replay hit/zero misses/equal snapshots/unchanged baseline stores, five publication/evidence hashes verified by strict readers) plus red→green logs for each closure gap; all are builder receipts, not independent execution, and live-provider acceptance correctly remains incomplete pending Sequence 6–7. Full-suite health: green only per the builder receipt bound to 0308e892, one evidence-only commit behind HEAD with tree equality builder-recorded (finding 3). Remote CI: unverified — local unpushed branch, correctly not claimed. No critical, high or medium finding is supported by the frozen evidence; the four findings above are low and non-blocking. Requirement coverage: R5.1–R5.5 unchanged from the first audit and re-confirmed where re-supplied; R5.6 closure items (direct acquisition journaling, worker context, scope binding, byte round-trip, unfinished-source incompleteness, frozen social clock, acquisition clock) each verified implemented with a matching committed regression; prior F1/F2 dispositions verified incorrect as recorded; F3/F4/F5 remain truthfully retained as disclosed non-blocking limits; F6's successor is finding 3 here.
limitations: Frozen-evidence-only audit: no test execution, runtime verification, network, GitHub access, or repository reads beyond the supplied request.json. All pytest/Ruff/native-CLI results (3358 passed at 0308e892; ruff clean; 1 replay hit/0 misses/12 model callback pairs/equal snapshots/unchanged baseline stores) are builder-supplied receipts, not independently rerun.

The packet supplies one combined diff for cc010ccd→7050666f; the split between the code commit 0308e892 and the evidence-only commit 7050666f cannot be independently reconstructed, so code-tree equality at audited HEAD rests on the builder-recorded git tree OIDs (finding 3).

Live-provider, live-vendor and paid-run behavior is unproven by design at this stage: StockTwits/Reddit/TypeSafe/Yahoo paths were exercised with synthetic producers and sockets denied per the receipts; real feed encodings, real Retry-After behavior and real TypeSafe payload shapes are unverified. findings.title: Comparison scope omits backend endpoint settings: `_prepare_attempt_comparison` binds providers, models, efforts, temperature, max_tokens, retries and tool/debate rounds, but not `backend_url`/`quick_think_backend_url`/`deep_think_backend_url` (used by `create_tier_client` at HEAD lines 2495–2510). Two runs pointed at different endpoints serving the same model names satisfy scope equality and can claim a controlled pair. Mitigation already present: per-call requested/actual model identity is recorded by AttemptRecorder, so endpoint-driven identity drift is still observable in the trace. Corrective direction: add the three endpoint keys to the scope settings tuple; verification is one more parametrized case in test_changed_model_settings_cannot_claim_same_comparison_scope. Source-grounded, not runtime-reproduced.

Non-typed acquisition failures remain unreplayable and force mixed-input comparisons: Reddit HTTPError/429 (raised inside acquire(), outside the three typed vendor errors), an oversized recorded feed (http.client.HTTPException re-raised after replay at reddit.py HEAD line ~9362), and requests exceptions in the TypeSafe path are journaled as {unreplayable_error} and re-raised; replay of those occurrences is a recorded miss that goes live. This retains the first audit's disclosed F4 limitation (confirmed, deferred) rather than regressing it: the failure is visible, status becomes mixed_input, and the controlled-proof gate correctly cannot pass. No correction required by the approved plan; a typed wrapper for HTTP-status failures would be the bounded extension if ever needed.

Full-suite (3358 passed/10 skipped/1 deselected) and native CLI receipts bind to code commit 0308e892, one evidence-only commit behind audited HEAD 7050666f. Tree equality is supported only by builder-recorded git tree OIDs (cli 9edfbf73, tradingagents 4b36389f, tests 1c531873, proof blob aa44fb91) in the verification JSON; the frozen packet supplies one combined cc010ccd→7050666f diff, so the docs-only nature of the final commit cannot be independently separated or re-hashed here. Same class as first-audit F6 (confirmed, action fix), now mitigated by the recorded OIDs and line map but still builder-asserted. Closes with any independent read of the two commits' tree IDs.

Replayed TypeSafe rate-limit responses re-sleep the recorded Retry-After during offline comparisons: system_one's loop sleeps `retry_after` (bounded at 30s by _retry_after/_MAX_WAIT) between replayed occurrences, so a baseline that recorded 429→200 sequences makes the candidate comparison wait the same real seconds per retried post (up to 16 concurrent workers amortize this). Behavioral fidelity is arguably intended; impact is wall-clock only, no correctness effect. Bounded correction if desired: skip the sleep when the next occurrence is already recorded. Source-grounded, not runtime-reproduced.
